{{Quote|I...I killed them. I killed them all. They're dead, every single one of them. And not just the men, but the women and the children too.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] confession to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="AotC" />}}
A '''Tusken village''' was located in the [[Valley of the Spirits]], an area of the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] near [[Fort Tusken/Legends|Fort Tusken]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was the site of a [[Mission to rescue Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|massacre]] carried out by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==Description==
The camp was set up by nomadic [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] in the barren wastes off the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]], and was considered to be on ancient Tusken hunting territory. This area was marked by the [[B'Thazoshe Bridge/Legends|B'Thazoshe Bridge]]. The huts that comprised the camp were made from animal skins stretched over a wooden or bone frame, and were easily portable in case of an emergency. The huts were arranged near a natural oasis, providing the Tuskens with a much-needed source of [[Water/Legends|water]]. Tuskens and their domesticated [[Massiff/Legends|massiffs]] guarded the site.

==History==
{{Quote|A deep act of anger occurred here many years ago. It warped the area and now the creatures here reflect that anger. Give them the peace that they deserve, but do not do so in hate.|[[Nos'lyn]]|<ref name="SWG:AaH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Jedi|First Steps: Anger and Harmony|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
[[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker Lars]] was taken to this camp after being captured by Tusken Raiders near the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]]. It was natural for a male Tusken to take a prisoner in order to prove his prowess to the tribe, and these victims were often subject to harsh rituals in order to test the fortitude and resilience of Tusken enemies. Shmi was no exception, and when her son, Anakin, finally found her, she was barely alive. Shmi [[Death/Legends|died]] in Anakin's arms, and the grief and rage Anakin felt at her passing resulted in his [[Mission to rescue Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|slaughter]] of the entire camp, during which not even women or children were spared.<ref name="AotC" /> Their [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]] presumably committed suicide after they found out about their riders' deaths since it was a common practice amongst the creatures.<ref name="The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

Following the incident, the site of the slaughter became known as a haunted area among the Tuskens, and prisoners were sacrificed here to appease the [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|ghost]] that supposedly roamed the camp. The camp remained in its desolate form to honor the Tuskens that had perished there.<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref> The area became a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Vergence/Legends|nexus]] strong with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]].<ref name="SWG:AaH" />

[[File:RuinedTuskenCamp.jpg|thumb|250px|The ruined Tusken Raider village during the Galactic Civil War.]]
In [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]], the site was visited by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] when driving in Darklighter's [[Selanikio Sportster|landspeeder]] after they shot some [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]] in [[Spice Siren/Legends|''Spice Siren'']] crash place area and seeing Tusken Raiders in the distance. After watching Tusken Raiders stop at the camp, they investigated, finding the ruins of the camp. They noticed the white Bantha ribs, skulls of Tuskens cut in half, and leather strips used to tie up Shmi Skywalker. After a feeling of dread passed over Biggs and Luke, they fled the camp.<ref name="ANH:TLoLS">''[[A New Hope: The Life of Luke Skywalker]]''</ref>

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nos'lyn]] led an aspiring Jedi to the Tusken village in order to instruct him in the ways of the Force and caution him about the dark side.<ref name="SWG:AaH" />

[[Kitster Chanchani Banai]] was taken in the village in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], intended to be one such victim, though he was [[Mission to Tatooine (Killik Twilight)|saved]] by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].<ref name="TG" />
